motion: The camera does not move. The bus is standing still at a stop, so the street outside does not move: the closed, whitewashed bank stays exactly where it is in the window the whole time. Rain streams down the window glass in thick running lines. The woman looks down at the glowing phone in her hands, then slowly lifts her eyes from it and turns her head to look out of the window at the closed bank across the street. The phone stays in her hand the whole time, resting on her knee, its screen still faintly lit. She stays very still, looking at the bank, for the rest of the shot. The window frame and the seats stay fixed in place. The camera does not move.
